title: Deep Imaging of Cleared Brain by Confocal Laser-Scanning Microscopy
protocol: Anesthetize an adult (6–40 weeks old) mouse via intraperitoneal injection of pentobarbital (Somnopentyl) (60 mg/kg body weight).
Transcardially perfuse the animal with 20 ml of ice-cold HBSS supplemented with heparin (10 units/ml) in 1 min.
Transcardially perfuse the animal with 40 ml of ice-cold 4% (wt/vol) PFA/PBS(–) in 2 min.
Dissect out the brain and postfix it with 25–30 ml of 4% (wt/vol) PFA/PBS(–) (pH 7.6–7.8) for 8–72 hrs at 4 ºC with mild shaking.
Store the sample in PBS(–) at 4 ºC until use but for not more than 1 week.
Transfer the sample into Sca_l_eS0 solution in a centrifuge tube.
Incubate the sample in Sca_l_eS0 at 37 ºC with gentle shaking (~70 rpm/min) for 12 hrs.
Replace Sca_l_eS0 solution with Sca_l_eS1.
Incubate the sample in Sca_l_eS1 at 37 ºC with gentle shaking (~70 rpm/min) for 12 hrs.
Replace Sca_l_eS1 solution with Sca_l_eS2.
Incubate the sample in Sca_l_eS2 at 37 ºC with gentle shaking (~70 rpm/min) for 12 hrs.
Replace Sca_l_eS2 solution with Sca_l_eS3.
Incubate the sample in Sca_l_eS3 at 37 ºC with gentle shaking (~70 rpm/min) for 12 hrs.
Replace Sca_l_eS3 solution with PBS(–).
Incubate the sample at 4 ºC for 6 hrs with gentle shaking (30–40 rpm/min).
Confirm turbid appearance of the deSca_l_ed sample.
Take pictures of the sample using a fluorescence stereomicroscope under the same conditions as before.
Replace PBS(–) with Sca_l_eS4D25.
Incubate the sample at 37 ºC with gentle shaking (~70 rpm/min) for 12 hrs.
Mix 1.5–2.5% wt/vol agarose in Sca_l_eS4D25(0) using a microwave oven (500 W) for 4 min.
Cool the mixture to 35-40°C.
Place the sample on the bottom of a plastic cup (depth: 4–5 cm, diameter: 8–10 cm).
Wipe up excessive Sca_l_eS4D25 solution around the sample with a Kim Wipe.
Leave the sample in the air for 10-15 minutes at room temperature to lightly dry the surface.
Drop the agarose solution on top of the sample using a polyvinyl pipette, ensuring it covers the entire sample.
Allow the agarose skirt to harden in the air for several hours or in a refrigerator when in a hurry.
Trim away the edges of the agarose skirt using a micro-spatula.
Remove any agarose fragments or debris completely with a Kim Wipe.
Wipe out the cup surface with a wet Kim Wipe and leave it in the air for 5 minutes.
Attach the rim of the agarose gel onto the cup surface by gluing at multiple points.
Wait approximately 10 minutes for complete fixation, checking by slanting the cup.
Gently pour an appropriate volume (1/4 volume of the cup capacity) of Sca_l_eS4D25 solution into the cup.
Equilibrate the sample to ScaleS4D25 by gentle shaking for 1 hour at room temperature.
Substitute fresh ScaleS4D25 or ScaleS4D2.5 solution for observation.
Immerse a dipping objective lens in ScaleS4D25 or ScaleS4D2.5 and approach it slowly to the sample.
Check the sample surface for air bubbles by eye before immersing the objective lens.
Remove any air bubbles on the sample surface gently with a bubble remover.
After immersion, check through the microscope for tiny air bubbles on the sample surface and remove them using the bubble remover.
Remove air bubbles trapped on the tip of the objective using the bubble-flusher.
Cover the surface of the medium with a thin plastic film made of Saran Wrap to prevent water evaporation during long CLSM observation (>12 hours).
Place the sample on the bottom of a plastic cup (depth: 4–5 cm, diameter: 8–10 cm).
Wipe up excessive ScaleS4D25 solution around the sample with Kim Wipe.
Leave the sample in the air for 10–15 minutes at room temperature to lightly dry the sample surface.
Make a hole with a diameter of 5–6 mm on a Parafilm sheet (5–6 cm square).
Place the Parafilm sheet over the sample, positioning the hole to the target area.
Attach the hem of the Parafilm sheet and the bottom surface using glue (Alon alpha A).
Gently pour an appropriate volume (1/4 volume of the cup capacity) of Sca_l_eS4D25 solution into the cup.
Equilibrate the sample with Sca_l_eS4D25 by gentle shaking for 1 hour at room temperature.
Substitute fresh Sca_l_eS4D25 or Sca_l_eS4D2.5 solution for observation.
Immerse a dipping objective lens in Sca_l_eS4D25 or Sca_l_eS4D2.5 and approach it slowly to the sample surface.
Check by eyes that there are no air bubbles on the sample surface before immersing the objective lens.
Remove any air bubbles on the sample surface through gentle scraping with a bubble-remover.
After immersion, check for tiny air bubbles on the sample surface through microscopy and remove them using a bubble-remover.
Remove any air bubbles trapped on the tip of the objective using a bubble-flusher.
Cover the surface of the mounting medium with a thin plastic film made of saran to prevent water evaporation.
